pharma.title: Drugmakers must report safety data from launch date, not approval date: CDSCO
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) mandated that drug manufacturers must submit safety data starting from the commercial launch date of a medicine rather than its approval date.

pharma.title: India's Drug Panel Recommends Wegovy for Metabolic Liver Disease Treatment
pharma.summary: India's subject expert panel under the drug regulator recommended the approval of Wegovy for treating metabolic liver disease.

pharma.title: GSK Moves Closer to India Launch of RSV Vaccine
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical major GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) progressed towards regulatory approval and launch of its Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) vaccine in India.

pharma.title: Aurobindo Arm CuraTeQ Clears Key CDSCO Hurdle for Bevacizumab Cancer Biosimilar
pharma.summary: CuraTeQ, a subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma, secured a major CDSCO clearance for its cancer biosimilar Bevacizumab.

pharma.title: AIIMS Bhopal Toll-Free Number To Report Harmful Effects Of Medicines
pharma.summary: AIIMS Bhopal launched a dedicated toll-free telephone number to enable citizens and medical staff to report adverse drug reactions and adverse effects of medicines.

national.title: Vijay, Tamil Nadu election results 2026: Film star takes oath as chief minister
national.summary: Actor Vijay was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu following the 2026 state assembly elections, leading a TVK government with a 35-member cabinet.

national.title: PM Modi asks Indians to return to WFH as global oil crisis worsens
national.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi advised citizens and organizations to temporarily switch back to work-from-home and delay non-essential foreign travel to conserve fuel amidst severe global oil disruptions.

international.title: Trump calls Iran's response to ceasefire proposal 'unacceptable'
international.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that Iran's response to the peace and ceasefire proposal put forward by the United States was completely unacceptable.

international.title: Ukraine and Russia accuse each other of breaking ceasefire
international.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchanged mutual accusations regarding alleged violations of an active ceasefire agreement.

economy.title: India’s informal sector becoming less indebted, also investing less
economy.summary: Data indicates that India's informal economic sector is experiencing lower debt levels alongside a decline in total capital investments.

economy.title: Middle East turmoil to keep oil prices elevated for years, dent India’s GDP growth: ADB chief economist
economy.summary: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) Chief Economist warned that sustained Middle East conflicts will keep global oil prices elevated for years, impacting India's GDP growth.

science.title: Reproductive cancers dominate India’s tally; women bear the brunt
science.summary: A recent health analysis reported that reproductive cancers account for the major share of cancer cases in India, affecting women disproportionately.

science.title: Surgery not required on Grade I spondylolisthesis patient- Consumer court slaps Rs 50 lakh compensation
science.summary: A consumer court awarded Rs 50 lakh in compensation after finding that surgery performed on a patient suffering from Grade I spondylolisthesis was unwarranted.

environment.title: Environmental checks must for data centres too, say scientists
environment.summary: Environmental scientists highlighted the urgent need for mandatory environmental impact assessments and resource regulation for data centres operating in India.

sports.title: Senior Women’s National Coaching Camp Announced by Hockey India
sports.summary: Hockey India announced the national coaching camp for the Senior Women's hockey team to prepare for upcoming international matches.

sports.title: Gagan Narang distributes five lakh pellets to mark Mother’s Day
sports.summary: Olympic shooting medalist Gagan Narang distributed five lakh airgun pellets to emerging shooters to mark Mother's Day.

awards_honours.title: Priyanka Chopra honoured with Global Vanguard Award at Gold Gala 2026
awards_honours.summary: Actor Priyanka Chopra was bestowed with the Global Vanguard Award at the Gold Gala 2026 event.

defence.title: India Names Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan As New Naval Chief
defence.summary: The Government of India named Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan as the next Chief of Naval Staff ahead of Admiral Tripathi's retirement.

defence.title: Australia, India deepen strategic defence partnership at 10th Defence Policy Talks
defence.summary: India and Australia reaffirmed their strategic defense ties during the 10th edition of the bilateral Defence Policy Talks.

schemes_appointments.title: SAIL appoints Ashok Kumar Panda as Chairman and Managing Director
schemes_appointments.summary: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) announced the appointment of Ashok Kumar Panda as its Chairman and Managing Director (CMD).

schemes_appointments.title: Bharat Bhushan appointed as Chairman of Andhra Pradesh FDC
schemes_appointments.summary: P. Bharat Bhushan was appointed as the Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Film, TV & Theatre Development Corporation.

schemes_appointments.title: Mother’s Day gift: CM launches Rs 3.5cr scheme to support youth leaving CCIs
schemes_appointments.summary: A state government launched a Rs 3.5 crore financial welfare scheme targeted at supporting young individuals transitioning out of Child Care Institutions (CCIs).

important_days.title: Happy Mother's Day 2026: A Global Celebration
important_days.summary: Mother's Day was observed globally on May 10, 2026, honoring maternal figures and their contributions to society.

important_days.title: National Technology Day Eve Celebrations
important_days.summary: Observances marked the eve of India's National Technology Day (May 11), commemorating the 1998 Pokhran-II nuclear tests.

mcqs.explanation: Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan has been named as the new Chief of Naval Staff ahead of Admiral Tripathi's retirement.

mcqs.q: Who was honored with the Global Vanguard Award at the Gold Gala 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Actor Priyanka Chopra was honored with the Global Vanguard Award at the Gold Gala 2026.

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Ashok Kumar Panda was appointed as the new Chairman and Managing Director of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).

mcqs.q: According to the Asian Development Bank (ADB) Chief Economist, which factor is anticipated to keep global oil prices elevated and impact India's GDP growth?
options: Major disruptions in South Asian monsoons
mcqs.explanation: The ADB Chief Economist stated that persistent Middle East turmoil will keep global oil prices elevated for years, negatively impacting India's GDP growth.
